<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    流程图模板 - CRAP 优化版
    用途: 业务流程、决策步骤、操作流程展示
    适用场景: 业务流程图、操作指南、决策树
    优化重点:
      - 对齐: 步骤卡片网格化布局
      - 对比: 不同类型节点视觉区分
      - 重复: 统一的卡片样式和连接线
      - 亲密性: 相关步骤分组，流程线清晰
    -->

    <defs>
        <!-- 整体背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FAFBFC;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F5F6F8;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- 主流程卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- 决策节点渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="decisionGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- 结束节点渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="endGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>

        <!-- 卡片阴影 -->
        <filter id="cardShadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="6" />
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" />
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2" />
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode />
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
            </feMerge>
        </filter>

        <!-- 箭头标记 -->
        <marker id="arrowBlue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto">
            <path d="M 0,0 L 10,5 L 0,10 Z" fill="#1976D2" />
        </marker>

        <marker id="arrowOrange" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto">
            <path d="M 0,0 L 10,5 L 0,10 Z" fill="#F57C00" />
        </marker>

        <marker id="arrowGreen" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto">
            <path d="M 0,0 L 10,5 L 0,10 Z" fill="#388E3C" />
        </marker>
    </defs>

    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)" />

    <!-- 标题区域 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="36"
        font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-0.5">
        <tspan>业务流程图</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="95" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="15"
        fill="#9AA0A6">
        <tspan>Business Process Flow · 标准化操作流程</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- 流程主区域 -->
    <g id="processFlow">
        <!-- 第一行：开始 → 步骤1 → 决策 -->

        <!-- 开始节点 -->
        <g id="start">
            <rect x="60" y="160" width="180" height="80" rx="40" fill="url(#cardGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="150" y="192" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="18"
                font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>开始</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="150" y="210" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Start</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 开始 → 步骤1 -->
        <line x1="240" y1="200" x2="300" y2="200" stroke="#1976D2" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowBlue)" />

        <!-- 步骤1：需求收集 -->
        <g id="step1">
            <rect x="300" y="160" width="200" height="80" rx="8" fill="url(#cardGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="400" y="192" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="17"
                font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>需求收集</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="400" y="210" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Requirement Gathering</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="400" y="227" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">
                <tspan>1-2 天</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 步骤1 → 决策 -->
        <line x1="500" y1="200" x2="560" y2="200" stroke="#1976D2" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowBlue)" />

        <!-- 决策节点：是否可行 -->
        <g id="decision1">
            <path d="M 660,160 L 740,200 L 660,240 L 580,200 Z" fill="url(#decisionGradient)"
                filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="660" y="197" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="16"
                font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>是否可行？</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="660" y="214" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Feasible?</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 决策箭头: 是 → 步骤2 -->
        <line x1="740" y1="200" x2="800" y2="200" stroke="#1976D2" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowBlue)" />
        <text x="740" y="178" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
            font-weight="600" fill="#388E3C">
            <tspan>是 Yes</tspan>
        </text>

        <!-- 决策箭头: 否 → 重新评估 (向下) -->
        <path d="M 660,240 L 660,280" stroke="#F57C00" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowOrange)" />
        <text x="680" y="265" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
            font-weight="600" fill="#E74C3C">
            <tspan>否 No</tspan>
        </text>

        <!-- 第二行：步骤2 → 步骤3 → 步骤4 -->

        <!-- 步骤2：方案设计 -->
        <g id="step2">
            <rect x="800" y="160" width="200" height="80" rx="8" fill="url(#cardGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="900" y="192" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="17"
                font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>方案设计</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="210" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Solution Design</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="227" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">
                <tspan>3-5 天</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 步骤2 → 下方 -->
        <path d="M 900,240 L 900,320" stroke="#1976D2" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowBlue)" />

        <!-- 重新评估节点 (第二行左侧) -->
        <g id="reevaluate">
            <rect x="560" y="280" width="200" height="80" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F57C00" stroke-width="3"
                filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="660" y="312" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="17"
                font-weight="700" fill="#F57C00" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>重新评估</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="660" y="330" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#F57C00" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>Re-evaluation</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="660" y="347" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#9AA0A6" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>调整需求</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 重新评估 → 步骤1 (回环) - 从左侧折线上升 -->
        <path d="M 560,320 L 280,320 L 280,240 L 300,240" stroke="#F57C00" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="5,5"
            marker-end="url(#arrowOrange)" fill="none" />
        <text x="255" y="280" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
            font-weight="500" fill="#F57C00">
            <tspan>重新收集</tspan>
        </text>

        <!-- 第三行：步骤3 → 步骤4 → 结束 -->

        <!-- 步骤3：开发实施 -->
        <g id="step3">
            <rect x="800" y="320" width="200" height="80" rx="8" fill="url(#cardGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="900" y="352" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="17"
                font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>开发实施</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="370" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Development</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="387" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">
                <tspan>7-14 天</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 步骤3 → 步骤4 -->
        <path d="M 900,400 L 900,480" stroke="#1976D2" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowBlue)" />

        <!-- 步骤4：测试验收 -->
        <g id="step4">
            <rect x="800" y="480" width="200" height="80" rx="8" fill="url(#cardGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="900" y="512" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="17"
                font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>测试验收</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="530" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="13"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Testing & Acceptance</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="900" y="547" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="12"
                fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.8">
                <tspan>2-3 天</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

        <!-- 箭头: 步骤4 → 结束 -->
        <line x1="1000" y1="520" x2="1060" y2="520" stroke="#388E3C" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowGreen)" />

        <!-- 结束节点 -->
        <g id="end">
            <rect x="1060" y="480" width="180" height="80" rx="40" fill="url(#endGradient)" filter="url(#cardShadow)" />
            <text x="1150" y="527" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"
                font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
                <tspan>完成</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="1150" y="545" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif"
                font-size="13" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.9">
                <tspan>Complete</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>
    </g>

    <!-- 图例说明 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <text x="60" y="480" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="16"
            font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F">
            <tspan>图例说明</tspan>
        </text>

        <!-- 流程步骤 -->
        <rect x="60" y="500" width="80" height="40" rx="6" fill="url(#cardGradient)" />
        <text x="150" y="525" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="14"
            font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368">
            <tspan>流程步骤</tspan>
        </text>

        <!-- 决策节点 -->
        <path d="M 100,570 L 130,590 L 100,610 L 70,590 Z" fill="url(#decisionGradient)" />
        <text x="150" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="14"
            font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368">

        <text x="150" y="655" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" font-size="14"

    <g id="timeInfo">

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="70" fill="#003366"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="6" height="70" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="40" y="46" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">Problem Statement</text>

  <!-- Key Message Bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="1280" height="45" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="6" height="45" fill="#0066CC"/>
  <text x="40" y="100" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>Current agent training blindly injects knowledge — like "flood irrigation" — regardless of situational need</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Content Area: Three cards for three paradigms -->
  <!-- Card 1: Trajectory Imitation -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 135)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="280" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="8" fill="#CC0000" rx="4"/>
    <text x="20" y="45" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold">1. Trajectory Imitation</text>
    <text x="20" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Examples: ReAct, basic agent methods</text>
    <text x="20" y="115" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>Indiscriminately copies gold trajectories.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="150" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>No self-awareness of when action is</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="175" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>correct vs. needs reflection.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="220" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">❌ Pattern collapse on unexpected inputs</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Card 2: Trial-and-Error -->
  <g transform="translate(440, 135)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="280" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="8" fill="#FFA500" rx="4"/>
    <text x="20" y="45" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold">2. Trial-and-Error Refinement</text>
    <text x="20" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Examples: Reflexion</text>
    <text x="20" y="115" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>Relies on external feedback to refine.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="150" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>Does not learn when to self-correct</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="175" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>vs. when to seek knowledge.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="220" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">❌ Fragile planning, high inference cost</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Card 3: Knowledge-Augmented -->
  <g transform="translate(840, 135)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="280" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="380" height="8" fill="#0066CC" rx="4"/>
    <text x="20" y="45" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold">3. Knowledge-Augmented</text>
    <text x="20" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Examples: KnowAgent, WKM</text>
    <text x="20" y="115" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>Blindly injects 100% external knowledge.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="150" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>No selectivity — wastes resources on</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="175" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15">
      <tspan>steps that don't need it.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="20" y="220" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">❌ Indiscriminate = inefficient & suboptimal</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom insight -->
  <rect x="40" y="450" width="1200" height="60" fill="#F5F7FA" rx="8"/>
  <text x="60" y="485" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">Humans possess situational self-awareness — the metacognitive ability to assess:</text>
  <text x="60" y="505" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>Can I act directly? → Need to reflect? → Must seek external knowledge?</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness</text>
  <text x="1200" y="695" text-anchor="end" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">2</text>
</svg>

  <line x1="740" y1="275" x2="740" y2="430" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>

  <polygon points="755,455 760,465 765,455" fill="#CC0000"/>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness</text>

  <!-- Header -->

  <text x="40" y="100" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>KnowSelf correctly handles tasks where general reasoning models fail</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Left side: Task 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 130)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="590" height="400" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="590" height="50" fill="#CC0000" rx="6"/>
    <text x="20" y="35" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">Task: "Put a hot mug in cabinet"</text>

    <!-- OpenAI O1 failure -->
    <text x="20" y="80" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">❌ OpenAI-O1 (General Reasoning)</text>
    <text x="20" y="110" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Incorrectly tries to take an egg from the</text>
    <text x="20" y="132" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">microwave after opening it.</text>
    <text x="20" y="165" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-style="italic">Fails: Object confusion in simple task</text>

    <!-- KnowSelf success -->
    <rect x="20" y="195" width="550" height="5" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
    <text x="20" y="230" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">✓ KnowSelf (Llama-8B)</text>
    <text x="20" y="260" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Uses Reflection token to realize the mug</text>
    <text x="20" y="282" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">should be heated using the open microwave</text>
    <text x="20" y="304" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">before placing in cabinet.</text>
    <text x="20" y="340" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">✓ Success: Proper action sequence</text>
    <text x="20" y="365" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">KnowSelf recognizes when reflection is needed</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Right side: Task 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(650, 130)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="590" height="400" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="590" height="50" fill="#0066CC" rx="6"/>
    <text x="20" y="35" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">Task: "Put a saltshaker in drawer"</text>

    <!-- DeepSeek-R1 failure -->
    <text x="20" y="80" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">❌ DeepSeek-R1 (General Reasoning)</text>
    <text x="20" y="110" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Reflects that the drawer is open and tries</text>
    <text x="20" y="132" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">to close it first — which fails.</text>
    <text x="20" y="165" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-style="italic">Fails: Over-complication of simple task</text>

    <!-- KnowSelf success -->
    <rect x="20" y="195" width="550" height="5" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
    <text x="20" y="230" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">✓ KnowSelf (Llama-8B)</text>
    <text x="20" y="260" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Applies Knowledge token — notes that the</text>
    <text x="20" y="282" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">agent should place the object without</text>
    <text x="20" y="304" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">removing unrelated items.</text>
    <text x="20" y="340" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">✓ Success: Correct knowledge application</text>
    <text x="20" y="365" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">KnowSelf recognizes when to seek knowledge</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom insight -->
  <rect x="40" y="555" width="1200" height="55" fill="#F5F7FA" rx="8"/>
  <text x="60" y="585" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Key Insight:</text>
  <text x="200" y="585" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>Situational self-awareness outperforms general reasoning — KnowSelf knows when to think, when to reflect, and when to seek knowledge.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness | Source: arxiv.org/abs/2504.03553</text>
  <text x="1200" y="695" text-anchor="end" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">5</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="70" fill="#003366"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="6" height="70" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="40" y="46" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">Key Takeaways</text>

  <!-- Key Message Bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="1280" height="45" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="6" height="45" fill="#0066CC"/>
  <text x="40" y="100" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>Self-Awareness Is the Missing Piece in Agent Planning</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Five key takeaways -->
  <!-- Takeaway 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 140)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="580" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="90" fill="#003366" rx="6"/>
    <text x="25" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">1</text>
    <text x="70" y="35" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Indiscriminate knowledge injection is wasteful</text>
    <text x="70" y="60" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Methods using 100% knowledge often underperform KnowSelf,</text>
    <text x="70" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">confirming that blanket application hurts rather than helps.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Takeaway 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(660, 140)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="580" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="90" fill="#003366" rx="6"/>
    <text x="25" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">2</text>
    <text x="70" y="35" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Agents can learn situational self-awareness via tokens</text>
    <text x="70" y="60" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Lightweight heuristic labeling on self-explored trajectories</text>
    <text x="70" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">enables autonomous cognitive resource regulation.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Takeaway 3 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 250)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="580" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="90" fill="#0066CC" rx="6"/>
    <text x="25" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">3</text>
    <text x="70" y="35" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Llama-8B KnowSelf outperforms GPT-4o baselines</text>
    <text x="70" y="60" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">84.33% vs 76.12% (GPT-4o ReAct) and 79.85%</text>
    <text x="70" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">(GPT-4o ExpeL) — selective use beats blanket injection.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Takeaway 4 -->
  <g transform="translate(660, 250)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="580" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D0D7E0" stroke-width="1" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="90" fill="#0066CC" rx="6"/>
    <text x="25" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">4</text>
    <text x="70" y="35" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Only 15-26% knowledge usage needed</text>
    <text x="70" y="60" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">vs 100% for competing methods — 4-6x efficiency gain</text>
    <text x="70" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">without sacrificing accuracy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Takeaway 5 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 360)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="2" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="90" fill="#28A745" rx="6"/>
    <text x="25" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">5</text>
    <text x="70" y="35" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Paradigm generalizes across model scales</text>
    <text x="70" y="60" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">Gemma-2B KnowSelf reaches 79.85%, matching GPT-4o ExpeL and exceeding all other Gemma-2B baselines —</text>
    <text x="70" y="80" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">demonstrating the approach scales down effectively while maintaining efficiency.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom highlight -->
  <rect x="40" y="480" width="1200" height="70" fill="#003366" rx="8"/>
  <text x="640" y="520" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold">The three-situation taxonomy (fast/slow/knowledgeable thinking)</text>
  <text x="640" y="545" text-anchor="middle" fill="#E8F4FC" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>provides a principled framework for agents to autonomously regulate cognitive resources — analogous to human metacognition.</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness | arxiv.org/abs/2504.03553</text>
  <text x="1200" y="695" text-anchor="end" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">8</text>
</svg>

arguments.content:
# KnowSelf Presentation Speaker Notes

---

# 01_cover

The presentation introduces KnowSelf, a groundbreaking framework for agentic knowledgeable self-awareness in LLM-based agents. We address a fundamental limitation in current agent training: indiscriminate knowledge injection that wastes resources and reduces effectiveness. KnowSelf enables agents to autonomously decide when to act directly, reflect, or seek external knowledge — analogous to human metacognition.

**Key points:**
① KnowSelf bridges the gap between unlimited knowledge access and efficient agent operation
② The framework is described in arxiv.org/abs/2504.03553
③ Target audience: ML researchers and graduate students studying LLM agents and planning systems

**Duration:** 30 seconds

---

# 02_problem

Current agent training methods fall into three categories — trajectory imitation, trial-and-error refinement, and knowledge-augmented planning — but all suffer from the same fundamental flaw: they treat knowledge as water poured through a "flood irrigation" system, without regard for actual situational needs.

**Key points:**
① ReAct and similar methods blindly copy gold trajectories without self-awareness
② Reflexion relies on external feedback without learning when to self-correct vs. seek knowledge
③ KnowAgent and WKM inject 100% external knowledge indiscriminately, wasting resources on steps that don't need it
④ Humans possess metacognitive self-awareness — we naturally assess: Can I act directly? Should I reflect? Must I seek help?

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 03_three_modes

KnowSelf defines three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step. The decision tree starts with a simple question: can the agent produce the correct action directly?

**Key points:**
① Fast Thinking: Agent produces correct action immediately — minimal deliberation needed, just act
② Slow Thinking: Initial action is incorrect but self-correctable through reflection — trigger reflection mechanism
③ Knowledgeable Thinking: Cannot produce correct action even after reflection — must consult external knowledge base
④ This taxonomy provides a principled framework for cognitive resource allocation, analogous to human metacognition

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 04_framework

The KnowSelf pipeline has three distinct stages. First, the agent self-explores environments while a heuristic classifier marks each step with special tokens indicating whether it's a fast, slow, or knowledgeable situation. Second, the agent undergoes two-stage training: supervised fine-tuning teaches initial patterns, then RPO refines token generation for appropriate situations. Third, during inference, special tokens trigger direct action, reflection, or knowledge retrieval.

**Key points:**
① Heuristic labeling requires no expensive human annotation — the agent teaches itself situational awareness
② Two-stage training (SFT + RPO) ensures both pattern learning and policy optimization
③ Special tokens provide a lightweight mechanism for self-aware inference
④ The framework is data-efficient and generalizes across model scales

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 05_qualitative

Let's examine two concrete task examples where general reasoning models fail but KnowSelf succeeds. In "put a hot mug in cabinet," OpenAI-O1 incorrectly tries to take an unrelated egg from the microwave after opening it — object confusion in a simple task. KnowSelf with Llama-8B uses a Reflection token to correctly realize the mug should be heated first before placing in the cabinet. Similarly, in "put a saltshaker in drawer," DeepSeek-R1 over-complicates the task by trying to close an open drawer first (which fails), while KnowSelf applies a Knowledge token to place the object directly without removing unrelated items.

**Key points:**
① Situational self-awareness outperforms general reasoning capabilities
② KnowSelf recognizes when reflection is needed vs. when to seek knowledge
③ General models struggle with object confusion and over-complication of simple tasks
④ The three-mode framework enables appropriate response selection

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 06_alfworld_results

Now let's examine the quantitative results on ALFWorld, a standard benchmark for interactive task completion. The table shows success rates across six task types with the Know% column indicating knowledge usage.

**Key data points:**
[Data] GPT-4o ReAct achieves 76.12% with 0% knowledge — baseline performance
[Data] GPT-4o ExpeL achieves 79.85% with 100% knowledge — significant investment
[Data] Llama-8B KnowSelf achieves **84.33%** with only **15.01%** knowledge — best overall
[Data] Gemma-2B KnowSelf achieves **79.85%** with only **26.41%** knowledge — matches GPT-4o ExpeL

**Key points:**
① Selective knowledge use (15%) outperforms blanket 100% injection
② Smaller models (Gemma-2B) benefit substantially from the framework
③ KnowSelf excels in Heat tasks (91.30%) where knowledge is crucial
④ The efficiency-accuracy tradeoff clearly favors KnowSelf's approach

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 07_efficiency

This chart illustrates the core efficiency advantage of KnowSelf. Each bar represents overall accuracy, with KnowSelf's dramatically lower knowledge usage (15-26%) contrasted against competitors' 100% knowledge consumption.

**Key data points:**
[Data] ReAct (0% KB): 27.6% (Llama) to 76.1% (GPT-4o) — baseline, no knowledge cost
[Data] ExpeL/KnowAgent/WKM (100% KB): 41-79.9% — full knowledge investment
[Data] KnowSelf Llama-8B (15% KB): **84.3%** — best accuracy, minimal knowledge
[Data] KnowSelf Gemma-2B (26% KB): **79.9%** — matches GPT-4o ExpeL at 1/4 the knowledge

**Key points:**
① 4-6x knowledge efficiency improvement over competing methods
② KnowSelf achieves the highest accuracy with the lowest knowledge usage
③ Selective knowledge application is superior to indiscriminate injection
④ The data conclusively demonstrates: **Selective > Indiscriminate**

**Duration:** 2 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

Let's summarize the five key findings from this research. First, indiscriminate knowledge injection is wasteful — methods using 100% knowledge often underperform KnowSelf's selective approach. Second, agents can learn situational self-awareness through lightweight heuristic labeling with special tokens, requiring no expensive human annotation. <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="70" fill="#003366"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="6" height="70" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="40" y="46" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">Three Situational Thinking Modes</text>

  <!-- Key Message Bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="1280" height="45" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="6" height="45" fill="#0066CC"/>
  <text x="40" y="100" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>KnowSelf defines three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Decision Tree Diagram -->
  <!-- Root node: "Agent at Decision Point" -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 160)">
    <rect x="-150" y="-30" width="300" height="60" fill="#003366" rx="30"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Agent at Decision Point</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow down from root -->
  <line x1="640" y1="195" x2="640" y2="235" stroke="#0066CC" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="635,230 640,240 645,230" fill="#0066CC"/>

  <!-- Decision diamond -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 275)">
    <path d="M 0,-50 L 120,0 L 0,50 L -120,0 Z" fill="#0066CC"/>
    <text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Can produce correct</tspan></text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">action directly?</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- YES branch (left) - Fast Thinking -->
  <line x1="520" y1="275" x2="200" y2="275" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="205,270 195,275 205,280" fill="#28A745"/>
  <text x="360" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">YES</text>

  <g transform="translate(100, 275)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-70" width="180" height="140" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-90" y="-70" width="180" height="8" fill="#28A745" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">⚡ Fast Thinking</text>
    <text x="0" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">Direct correct action</text>
    <text x="0" y="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">with minimal</text>
    <text x="0" y="52" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">deliberation</text>
    <text x="0" y="75" text-anchor="middle" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">✓ Act directly</text>
  </g>

  <!-- NO branch (right) -->
  <line x1="760" y1="275" x2="1080" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="1075,270 1085,275 1075,280" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="920" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">NO</text>

  <!-- Second decision diamond -->
  <g transform="translate(1080, 275)">
    <path d="M 0,-50 L 100,0 L 0,50 L -100,0 Z" fill="#FFA500"/>
    <text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Can self-correct</tspan></text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">via reflection?</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- YES (reflection works) - Slow Thinking -->
  <line x1="1080" y1="325" x2="1080" y2="450" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="1075,445 1080,455 1085,445" fill="#28A745"/>
  <text x="1100" y="390" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">YES</text>

  <g transform="translate(1080, 490)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-60" width="180" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-90" y="-60" width="180" height="8" fill="#FFA500" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold">🧠 Slow Thinking</text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">Incorrect initially,</text>
    <text x="0" y="35" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">self-correctable through</text>
    <text x="0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">reflection</text>
  </g>

  <!-- NO (reflection fails) - Knowledgeable Thinking -->
  <line x1="980" y1="275" x2="760" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="765,270 755,275 765,280" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="870" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">NO</text>

  <g transform="translate(640, 490)">
    <rect x="-100" y="-60" width="200" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0066CC" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-100" y="-60" width="200" height="8" fill="#0066CC" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold">📚 Knowledgeable</text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">Cannot produce correct</text>
    <text x="0" y="35" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">action even after</text>
    <text x="0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">reflection — consult KB</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Connecting arrow to Knowledgeable thinking -->
  <line x1="760" y1="275" x2="740" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="740" y1="275" x2="740" y2="430" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="740" y1="430" x2="760" y2="430" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="760" y1="430" x2="760" y2="460" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="755,455 760,465 765,455" fill="#CC0000"/>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness</text>
  <text x="1200" y="695" text-anchor="end" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">3</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="70" fill="#003366"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="6" height="70" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="40" y="46" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">Three Situational Thinking Modes</text>

  <!-- Key Message Bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="1280" height="45" fill="#E8F4FC"/>
  <rect x="0" y="70" width="6" height="45" fill="#0066CC"/>
  <text x="40" y="100" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16">
    <tspan>KnowSelf defines three cognitive situations based on the agent's ability at each decision step</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- Decision Tree Diagram -->
  <!-- Root node: "Agent at Decision Point" -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 160)">
    <rect x="-150" y="-30" width="300" height="60" fill="#003366" rx="30"/>
    <text x="0" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Agent at Decision Point</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow down from root -->
  <line x1="640" y1="195" x2="640" y2="235" stroke="#0066CC" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="635,230 640,240 645,230" fill="#0066CC"/>

  <!-- Decision diamond -->
  <g transform="translate(640, 275)">
    <path d="M 0,-50 L 120,0 L 0,50 L -120,0 Z" fill="#0066CC"/>
    <text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Can produce correct</tspan></text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">action directly?</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- YES branch (left) - Fast Thinking -->
  <line x1="520" y1="275" x2="200" y2="275" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="205,270 195,275 205,280" fill="#28A745"/>
  <text x="360" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">YES</text>

  <g transform="translate(100, 275)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-70" width="180" height="140" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-90" y="-70" width="180" height="8" fill="#28A745" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">⚡ Fast Thinking</text>
    <text x="0" y="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">Direct correct action</text>
    <text x="0" y="30" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">with minimal</text>
    <text x="0" y="52" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="13">deliberation</text>
    <text x="0" y="75" text-anchor="middle" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">✓ Act directly</text>
  </g>

  <!-- NO branch (right) -->
  <line x1="760" y1="275" x2="1080" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="1075,270 1085,275 1075,280" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="920" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">NO</text>

  <!-- Second decision diamond -->
  <g transform="translate(1080, 275)">
    <path d="M 0,-50 L 100,0 L 0,50 L -100,0 Z" fill="#FFA500"/>
    <text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Can self-correct</tspan></text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">via reflection?</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- YES (reflection works) - Slow Thinking -->
  <line x1="1080" y1="325" x2="1080" y2="450" stroke="#28A745" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="1075,445 1080,455 1085,445" fill="#28A745"/>
  <text x="1100" y="390" fill="#28A745" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">YES</text>

  <g transform="translate(1080, 490)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-60" width="180" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-90" y="-60" width="180" height="8" fill="#FFA500" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold">🧠 Slow Thinking</text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">Incorrect initially,</text>
    <text x="0" y="35" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">self-correctable through</text>
    <text x="0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">reflection</text>
  </g>

  <!-- NO (reflection fails) - Knowledgeable Thinking -->
  <line x1="980" y1="275" x2="760" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="765,270 755,275 765,280" fill="#CC0000"/>
  <text x="870" y="265" text-anchor="middle" fill="#CC0000" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">NO</text>

  <g transform="translate(640, 490)">
    <rect x="-100" y="-60" width="200" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0066CC" stroke-width="3" rx="8"/>
    <rect x="-100" y="-60" width="200" height="8" fill="#0066CC" rx="4"/>
    <text x="0" y="-20" text-anchor="middle" fill="#003366" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold">📚 Knowledgeable</text>
    <text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">Cannot produce correct</text>
    <text x="0" y="35" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">action even after</text>
    <text x="0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333333" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">reflection — consult KB</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Connecting arrow to Knowledgeable thinking -->
  <line x1="760" y1="275" x2="740" y2="275" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="740" y1="275" x2="740" y2="430" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="740" y1="430" x2="760" y2="430" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="760" y1="430" x2="760" y2="460" stroke="#CC0000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="755,455 760,465 765,455" fill="#CC0000"/>

  <!-- Footer -->
  <line x1="40" y1="665" x2="1240" y2="665" stroke="#E8F7FC" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="695" fill="#999999" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="12">KnowSelf: Agentic Knowledgeable Self-Awareness</text>
  <text x="1200" y="695" text-anchor="end" fill="#666666" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14">3</text>
</svg>

I see the issue. In lines 28-29:
```
<text x="0" y="-10" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Can produce correct</tspan></text>
<text x="0" y="15" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">action directly?</tspan></text>
```

This is invalid XML because the `</text>` comes right after `</tspan>`. In proper SVG, `<tspan>` elements must be inside a `<text>` element, and they can't close like that. The correct structure should be:
```
<text ...>Can produce correct<tspan>action directly?</tspan></text>
```

Let me fix this by removing the extra closing tags.
